caption: The drawing depicts a single metal watering can against a plain, light beige background. The can has a conical body that widens toward the bottom and is mostly a muted greenish-brown color with hints of rust and patina, indicating worn metal. The spout is long and narrow, extending to the left, and the handle is a simple curved wire loop attached near the top and side, extending to the right. The top has a cylindrical, slightly tilted lid with a flattened, circular top and a small knob. There is also a narrow, twisted wire or rod hinged at the top of the spout and the side of the lid, which appears to be part of the pivot mechanism for the spout or lid. The composition places the watering can centrally on the page with no other objects or background details present.
title: Whale Oil Can
